provenance.summary: Seeded from verified monitor totals for Nov 1–6, 2026 and from run-level journals whose daily sums match those totals. No X API call was made from this repository. Per-account profile rankings are omitted until a verified account export is ingested.
sources: Verified daily monitor totals: Nov 1 = 41 (40 AM + 1 PM, excluding 7 preexisting), Nov 2 = 17, Nov 3 = 13, Nov 4 = 1, Nov 5 = 378 (11 + 179 + 188), total 450 through Nov 5
Nov 6 partial: 110 verified at 11:35 AM ET from an approved 347 batch, 237 remaining, later routine interrupted
Run journals for clock times, list size, and already-blocked counts where they add up to those daily totals. The Nov 1 PM block is the 9:00 PM ET run
Point-in-time snapshots: Nov 5 11:35 PM ET (X blocks 453, list 561, 127 unblocked on the list), Nov 6 9:00 AM ET (list 775, 428 blocked, 347 unblocked, X blocks 452), Nov 6 11:35 AM ET (X blocks 562)

list.name: AI slop posters
list.description: Community-curated list monitored by the block routine (journal name: Block AI slop list). Membership is a community assessment of AI slop posters, not independent evidence.

monitoring.preexisting_note: Seven accounts were already blocked when monitoring started on Nov 1, 2026. They are excluded from every newly blocked total on this site.

events.provenance: Routine journal, first monitor run on Nov 1, 2026 at 9:00 AM ET.
events.notes: 40 newly blocked. The 7 already blocked are the preexisting accounts excluded from new_blocks.

events.provenance: Routine journal, Nov 1, 2026 at 9:00 PM ET. This is the PM addition in the daily total of 41.
events.notes: One newly blocked account. Together with the morning 40 this is the Nov 1 total of 41.

events.provenance: Routine journal, Nov 2, 2026 at 3:00 PM ET.
Routine journal, Nov 2, 2026 at 9:00 PM ET.
events.notes: 16 newly blocked. The journal recorded the count without a complete handle list. Nov 2 total is 17.

events.provenance: Routine journal, Nov 3, 2026 at 9:00 AM ET.
events.notes: Nine newly blocked. Handles were not recorded as a complete list.

events.provenance: Routine journal, Nov 3, 2026 at 3:00 PM ET.
Routine journal, Nov 3, 2026 at 9:00 PM ET.
events.notes: Two newly blocked accounts. Nov 3 total is 13.

events.provenance: Routine journal, Nov 4, 2026 at 9:00 AM ET.
events.notes: Morning run recorded no newly blocked accounts.

events.provenance: Routine journal, Nov 4, 2026 at 3:00 PM ET.
events.notes: One newly blocked account. This is the entire Nov 4 total.

events.provenance: Routine journal, Nov 4, 2026 at 9:00 PM ET.
events.notes: Evening run recorded no newly blocked accounts.

events.provenance: Routine journal, Nov 5, 2026 at 9:00 AM ET.
events.notes: 11 newly blocked before the two approved batches. Handles were not recorded as a complete list.

events.provenance: User-approved batch t3s15, Nov 5, 2026 at 3:00 PM ET.
events.notes: Approved 179-block batch. Individual handles were not stored in this seed.

events.provenance: User-approved batch t3s21, Nov 5, 2026 at 9:00 PM ET.
End-of-day verify at 11:35 PM ET on Nov 5, 2026 recorded no further monitor blocks.
events.notes: No additional monitor blocks after the approved batches. List and X block figures for this instant are on the matching snapshot, not in this event.

events.provenance: Original 11:35 AM ET Nov 6, 2026 partial verify of 110 within the approved 347; superseded by the completed-day event at 21:00.
events.notes: Superseded so the completed approved batch is counted once as 347 on monitor-new:2026-11-06:21:00. Kept visible per contract.

events.provenance: Verified completion of the Nov 6, 2026 approved 347-account batch: 110 by 11:35 AM ET, 90 more before the 9 PM run, and 147 in the 9 PM ET run (completion report).
events.notes: Authoritative Nov 6 newly-blocked total for the approved batch. handles lists the 237 known after the 11:35 checkpoint (90 mid-batch + 147 at 9 PM); the first 110 handles were not retained, so handles_complete is false. Replaces the superseded 110 partial for totals.

events.provenance: Post-completion verify from ai-slop-347-completion-report.json as of 9:43 PM ET on Nov 6, 2026.
events.notes: No further monitor blocks after finishing the 347. 37 newer list members remain unblocked pending user decision (1 followed: mdp_sec).

snapshots.provenance: End-of-day verify recorded at 11:35 PM ET on Nov 5, 2026.
snapshots.notes: Point-in-time. X blocked accounts 453. Curated list 561 members, of which 127 were outside the approved batches. Blocked-on-list was not stated separately and is not invented here. Not a reconciliation to the monitor sum of 450.

snapshots.provenance: Nov 6, 2026 9:00 AM ET list observation, before the partial 347 batch.
snapshots.notes: Timestamp only. 428 list members blocked and 347 not blocked sum to the list size of 775. X blocks 452 is the full block list, distinct from the monitor sum.

snapshots.provenance: Nov 6, 2026 11:35 AM ET verify while an approved 347-account batch was incomplete.
snapshots.notes: Total X blocks at this timestamp. List size was not re-counted here. The monitor had verified 110 new blocks, with 237 still remaining. Do not treat the day as finished.

snapshots.provenance: Nov 6, 2026 9:43 PM ET completion report after finishing the approved 347 batch.
snapshots.notes: Point-in-time. 759+37=796. X blocks 798 is the full block list, not the monitor sum. Monitor complete days Nov 1-5 = 450; Nov 6 = 347. Note: 452 (AM X blocks) + 347 = 799 vs observed 798 — one-account discrepancy left unresolved.

snapshots.provenance: Fully paginated X list members and block list at 11:37:39 PM ET on Nov 6, 2026 via user-X reads (8 list pages, 9 block pages).
snapshots.notes: Point-in-time live recount. List https://x.com/i/lists/2116659176894071283. API member_count 794; fetched 794. 757+37=794. X blocks 798. Same 37 unblocked handles as the 9:43 PM completion report; list size fell 796→794 and blocked-on-list 759→757 since then (2 members left the list).

open_work.provenance: Approved batch of 347 list accounts finished at 9:43 PM ET on Nov 6, 2026.
open_work.notes: Closed. related new_blocks 347 + remaining 0 = approved_count 347. Prior interrupted remaining 237 is obsolete.

open_work.provenance: 37 newer curated-list members were unblocked at 9:43 PM ET on Nov 6, 2026 and await a user decision; not blocked by the routine.
open_work.notes: Pending user decision on 37 newer list members (not yet approved to block). related new_blocks 0 + remaining 37 = 37. Followed among them: mdp_sec. Do not auto-block.
